notes.subject: fix(redaction): redact env-style *_KEY names and known provider key values
notes.summary: Settings and mise config redaction now also hides environment-style names ending in _KEY, _TOKEN, _SECRET or _PASSWORD and values with well-known provider key prefixes, which were previously returned in full.

notes.subject: fix(edit): save and match documents by file identity, not path string
notes.summary: Edits to files on case-insensitive volumes such as SMB shares now save correctly and are verified on disk, and apply_diff no longer refuses when the path casing differs from the open document.
